Strict digest registration preserves same-id/same-digest idempotency, quarantines same-id/different-digest evidence, handles older offsets as no-ops, supports covered contiguous fast paths only for current eligible authority, and blocks reads for unresolved or gap inbox state.

Owner recovery never regresses relationship revision and atomically couples projection CAS, exact offset recovery, GAP DEFERRED-only or zero-inbox baseline settlement, replay audit and service audit. The read guard rejects non-CURRENT, expired, non-current-date, authority-mismatched, unresolved-inbox or structurally corrupt facts; fenced baseline/refresh scheduling, malformed-row isolation, reconciliation and allowlisted operator quarantine recovery are covered without leave, balance or approval mutation.

Runtime assembly is conditional on a default-false switch, enrollment defaults to the empty set, fail-closed adapters are used, and no route, menu, production broker binding, tenant activation, customer database execution or business-completion credit is introduced.
